candidates.concept: TWO TRAILS SPLIT, ONE GOES HOME
candidates.compositionSketch: split: left — a dim trail curves back to a small cluster of house-blocks; right — a gold trail runs from the same origin past the cluster to the frame edge. One label under each.
candidates.whyDifferent: Other candidates act on opinions or boundaries; this one literally enacts 'mereka pulang' as diverging geometry — separation, not filtering.
candidates.strength: Two lines leaving one point and never rejoining tells 'your life is yours' with no narration; the cluster reads instantly as 'their home'.

candidates.compositionSketch: typographyDominant: counter reads 'DISUKAI 12.481 / 12.482'; each time the numerator ticks up, the denominator ticks up too and the thin fill bar stays stuck at 99.9%.
candidates.whyDifferent: Instead of separating paths or walls, it proves impossibility arithmetically — the goal moves away as fast as you approach it.
candidates.strength: Watching the numerator win and still lose is self-evident; the stuck bar makes universal approval visibly unreachable.

candidates.concept: OPINIONS HALT AT THE LINE, LIFE CONTINUES
candidates.compositionSketch: leftTextRightObject: left text; right — short dim opinion ticks fly in and stop dead at a vertical teal boundary, piling up; through it one gold line continues unbroken to the edge.
candidates.whyDifferent: Enacts the control-boundary as physics (blocked vs passing) rather than as a dial, a door, or reformatting of text.
candidates.strength: Ticks piling uselessly while your line keeps going shows 'their judgment stops here, your life doesn't' without explanation.

candidates.concept: JUDGMENT MARKS SHED FROM THE CIRCLE
candidates.compositionSketch: centered: a circle carries dim ticks stuck to its rim (labels: CARA NGOMONG, POSTINGAN, KEBAIKAN); ticks detach and fall away one by one — the circle settles larger with a teal rim.
candidates.whyDifferent: Where c1 splits and c3 blocks, this removes weight already attached — self-compassion shown as unloading rather than defending.
candidates.strength: Physical shedding of stuck-on marks reads as relief; the circle growing after each drop makes the benefit of letting go visible.

candidates.concept: THE PLEASING RING OPENS AND YOU WALK OUT
candidates.compositionSketch: objectDominant: a teal ring draws itself nearly full around center (fading labels: MEREKA, PENILAIAN, SUKA), then the final arc refuses to close — a gap opens in gold and the held dot exits.
candidates.whyDifferent: Treats the problem as a self-reinforcing loop that gets broken, not as a wall, a counter, or a diverging path.
candidates.strength: A ring that almost closes but won't, plus one object exiting through the gap, states the release: the cycle ends because you stop completing it.
